text:
sam (sales): Hi @sasha — quick sync on the MNFRx POC. Sasha said they need SSO + SCIM + RBAC + domain proofing before legal signs. Can we confirm POC steps and any blockers?

sasha (customer): Thanks Sam. Yes — must use SAML (Okta), SCIM provisioning but only a subset of groups (engineering + ops), RBAC with a tenant_admin role, and domain verification for their corp domain. Also need pricing for a 4-week dedicated proof-of-concept vs hosted test.

ana (solutions): @sasha we can do a 4-week Dedicated POC with reserved capacity. Pricing estimate: Dedicated POC minimum $Xk/mo (discounted), hosted eval can run on metered usage — I'll DM exact numbers. For SAML/SCIM we need SAML metadata + SCIM base URL and a service account token from you.

devon (eng): Quick engineering notes: our SCIM supports group filtering via ?filter=displayName eq \"engineering\". Delta syncs are available but POC can use full sync. SCIM rate limit during POC is 10 reqs/sec. For SAML we'll accept metadata XML from Okta or the IdP's redirect/ACS URL.

mike (security): From security side: they requested KMS-managed keys for Private deployments and SOC2 report + pen test summary. @sasha can you confirm which environment (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) they want for the POC and whether PII will be uploaded? That affects encryption+contract terms.

sasha (customer): Prefer Dedicated for isolation. We'll have user emails and some hashed identifiers, no raw PII. KMS required. We also have a security questionnaire (NDA signed) — can you return the completed one by EOW?

sam (sales): Noted. Action items: 1) Sasha to share Okta metadata + SCIM token and sample group list. 2) Ana to send Draft POC quote + contract addendum for Dedicated POC. 3) Devon to prepare SCIM test endpoint details and an engineering-runbook for onboarding. 4) Mike to attach SOC2/pen test docs and complete sec questionnaire.

ana (solutions): I'll open a purchase order template and attach pricing matrix. For domain proofing we support both TXT record verification and email-based verification to admin@<domain>. If they prefer DNS control is easiest: add TXT _redwood_verification=abc123.

devon (eng): SCIM test snippet for them to test provisioning (we'll provide full host in PM):
```bash
curl -X POST \"https://scim.redwood.example.com/v2/Users\" 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>\" 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" 
  -d '{\"userName\":\"alice@mnfrx.com\",\"displayName\":\"Alice Eng\"}'
```

mike (security): I'll upload SOC2 link + our compliance pack to the portal and run through their questionnaire. sec-bot, mark security questionnaire in progress for MNFRx.

sec-bot: Security questionnaire MNFRx-2026 submitted by mike (security). Status: In progress. Link: https://redwood-secure.example.com/questionnaires/MNFRx-2026

sasha (customer): Got it. We'll try DNS TXT, will send Okta metadata by tomorrow. Also: do you support SCIM partial provisioning (only push groups we specify) and custom attributes for role mapping?

devon (eng): Yes — we support group-based provisioning and custom attribute mapping. For RBAC you can map SCIM groups -> tenant_admin role; we also support attribute-based mapping (e.g., enterpriseRole=admin). I'll include mapping examples in the runbook.

sam (sales): Great progress. I'll schedule a 30min kickoff tomorrow 10am PT with engineering + security + customer. Anyone object?

ana (solutions): Works for me.

mike (security): Works. I'll have initial answers to the questionnaire by then.

sasha (customer): 10am PT works. Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast turn.
